# A document that loads the index package itself

Quarto emits the extension's package load conditionally, so a document that has
already loaded `imakeidx` keeps its own options and nothing the filter emits
can reach that load. What keeps the index file open past the marker is no
longer a package option: it is a group around `\printindex` that sets
`imakeidx`'s own switch for that one command, and a group works whoever loaded
the package and however. So a term marked below the marker still reaches this
document's index.

One term is marked before the marker: [zeta]{.index}.

::: {.qi-index-here}
:::

# After the marker

One term is marked after it, [omega]{.index}, which is the term this document
exists to show still reaching the index.
